provenance: SYNTHETIC SIMULATION ONLY: real headless Next UI with loopback fake Auth/API. No live backend, real login/sailing/traffic or participant evidence.
checks: Unauthenticated departure is protected
Synthetic sign-in reaches the protected departure page
Automatic SAFE; simulation source; result heading focused
Catalog target retains binding and unknown metadata
RISKY / risky preserves signed buffer and target
MISSED / missed preserves signed buffer and target
MISSED / fraction preserves signed buffer and target
Alternative selection keeps road date/time and recalculates
UNAVAILABLE unavailable has no alternatives or decision buffer
UNAVAILABLE empty has no alternatives or decision buffer
UNAVAILABLE stale has no alternatives or decision buffer
UNAVAILABLE fallback has no alternatives or decision buffer
UNAVAILABLE truncated has no alternatives or decision buffer
outage removes success and offers retry
malformed removes success and offers retry
422/mismatch/404 link corrective fields
Invalid form does not call API and focuses linked field
Edit and Stop discard delayed completions
Fixed-duration road-time action clears result and waits for Calculate
No alternatives and selected-target truncation remain explicit
Desktop/mobile screenshots and no horizontal overflow
Real Tab/Shift-Tab traversal, source toggle and touch targets at 375 px
Keyboard Stop cancels the pending request
A slower old SAFE request cannot replace a newer RISKY result
401 clears results and requires sign-in
Logout and another account clear all departure state
scope: Isolated headless Chromium with synthetic Auth/API; actual Tab/Shift-Tab traversal. Layout screenshots require recorded inspection; no real login/backend acceptance.
